'''Kay-Tap square''' was located in one of the cities on [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] around the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was where [[Wee Dunn/Legends|Wee Dunn]] and his mother [[Mahtee Dunn/Legends|Mahtee Dunn]] lived. Some time during the Clone Wars [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] [[Second mission to Rodia/Legends|went there]] to stop the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] from kidnapping Wee Dunn.
